name: autonomous-development-orchestrator
description: Local-first development orchestrator: plans a task with a reasoning model, applies code changes inside one workspace folder, verifies them with the project's own checks, and keeps them only if they hold up.

scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && tsx apps/server/src/server.ts
